items.summary: Financial recommendation: retain the three revalidations only as capacity-gated, no-spend work. Do not claim revenue, contribution margin, ROI, causal lift, or forecasted upside. The 2026-09-21 Amazon window reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, but all commission is in aggregate tracking_id other; site-attributed income is $0. The 2026-10-01 AI snapshot reports $10.8396 across only 11 of 38 expected instrumented sites, so fleet AI cost and cost-to-learn are incomplete. Contribution margin is not calculable because direct infrastructure, domain, labor, and site-level revenue allocation are unavailable. Minimum measurement: reconcile registered tracking IDs to site/content, capture direct cost by site and change, and record implementation effort/time. Proceed only after capacity is reconciled and measure clicks/CTR/LCP with explicit thresholds; finance approval does not authorize spending, billing, banking, contracts, or legal/tax decisions.
